criterion: The response is a single PDF containing an itemized reimbursement claim and a cover note written from Kayla to the Society's director.
The response restricts claimed items to expenses incurred during May 2026 that are attributable to the exhibit reception or to other Society volunteer activity.
The response values the print-vendor invoice at the lower amount written and initialed by the director in the invoice margin, rather than at the higher printed line total.
The response excludes the linen-rental charge after confirming against the Society's QuickBooks that this expense was already reimbursed to Kayla.
The response excludes the photographed retail receipt that has no connection to the exhibit reception or to any documented Society volunteer purpose.
The response identifies the unreadable receipt photograph as illegible and assigns it no dollar amount in the total.
The response itemizes the cash-paid reception parking expense at the amount shown on the handwritten note.
The response includes both the out-of-pocket catering charge and the out-of-pocket audio-rental charge for the reception, neither of which the Society's QuickBooks records as already reimbursed.
The response's inclusion and exclusion decisions are consistent with the Society's QuickBooks reimbursement records for Kayla Morgan.
The response reports a reimbursable total equal to the sum of the included line items, with the already-reimbursed and unreadable items left out of that sum.
The agent verifies the bookkeeper's pre-departure email claims against the Society's QuickBooks and the source documents rather than adopting them at face value.
The response's cover note states the total being claimed and is addressed to the Society's director.
The response values the print-vendor invoice at the printed line total, ignoring the director-initialed handwritten margin adjustment.
The response includes the linen-rental charge that the Society's QuickBooks already records as reimbursed to Kayla.
The response includes the unrelated retail receipt as a Society-reimbursable line.
The response assigns a fabricated or guessed dollar amount to the unreadable receipt and includes it in the reimbursable total.
The agent adopts the bookkeeper's pre-departure assertions about what is already reimbursed without verifying them against the Society's QuickBooks.
The response omits one of the out-of-pocket reception vendor charges (catering or audio rental) that the Society's QuickBooks shows no reimbursement for.
The agent issues a write request (POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE) to any of the connected services during the task.
